segments.name: Crypto mining
segments.description: The Group mines Bitcoin and other crypto assets using purpose-built mining machines at facilities in North America.
segments.evidence: The directors consider that the Group has only one significant reporting segment being crypto mining which is fully earned by USA subsidiary for the financial year ended 31 December 2025.

revenueModel.text: The Group earns rewards and fees denominated in the native blockchain asset for verifying blocks, and sells its mined Bitcoin weekly to fund operating expenses and working capital needs.
revenueModel.evidence: In 2025, 2024, and 2023, our treasury management strategy was to sell our mined Bitcoin on a weekly basis in order to fund our operating expenses and for working capital needs.

changes.text: In 2022 the Company sold its Helios facility and shifted to a hosting model, and in 2024 it sold the Mirabel facility.
changes.evidence: In December 2022, we sold the Helios facility, which we designed, constructed, and energized over the course of 2021 and 2022.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company sold the Mirabel facility and now owns and operates only its Baie Comeau data center.
changes.evidence: After selling the Mirabel facility in March 2024, Argo continues to own and operate its data center in Baie Comeau, Quebec.
